description: Export the posting schedule to a Notion database, one row per post: date, channels, caption, media link and status. Creates a new database (under parentPageId, or private in the workspace) or writes into an existing one (databaseId), matching its columns by name. historyDays adds posts already published. Up to 100 rows per run; the answer says if more were left. Free.

databaseId.description: an existing database id or link

historyDays.description: 0-90 days of published posts to include

name: export_schedule_to_notion
title: Export the schedule to Notion
